messages:
alex: Noticed mid-stream auth failure on frontdoor in staging. Client stream stalls then EPIPE when upstream rejects after token refresh. Repro below.

mira: Can you drop the repro and env?

alex: Staging, simple repro:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer shortlived' https://frontdoor.redwood/v1/stream -d @chat.json
# trigger auth refresh for that subject while stream active
```
Stream stalls then raw close, no structured error.

sam: Two axes: enforcement point (frontdoor vs upstream) and continuity (block vs delegate vs amortize).

ingrid: Proposal: conn-lease amortization. Frontdoor mints a short-lived signed lease (x-rdwl-conn-lease) when token is near expiry. Upstream can honor the lease for a small grace window (5–30s) so streams continue without blocking.

joel: Security notes: bind lease to TLS session or client fingerprint, short TTL, route-scoped rights, single-connection binding to reduce replay. Audit issuance.

alex: Fallback: graceful server trailer with resume_hint token so clients can resume when upstream rejects. Requires upstream changes.

sam: Suggest per-route config, e.g.:
```
route.auth_policy = "amortize|eager_check|reject_and_resume"
route.resume_policy = "none|client_initiated|server_trailer"
```

ingrid: Metrics & rollout: lease_issued, lease_violations, midstream_auth_rejects, resume_attempts. Dark launch leases, monitor violations, then opt-in routes.

mira: Testing: unit tests for header handling, integration test with fake auth slow refresh, chaos in staging toggling policies.

joel: Ask security for a quick review focused on replay/privilege escalation.

alex: Action items: ingrid RFC + diagram (ETA Tue), sam list eager routes (ETA Mon), mira test harness (ETA Fri), alex sync with model-serving (ETA Wed).

deploy-bot: feature-flag created in staging: frontdoor.conn_lease :white_check_mark:
